brief: Write the November newsletter for our 4-H club, the Clover Creek Champions in Bremen, Indiana. Facts: 23 members this year, up from 17; at the Marshall County fair in July, Hannah Yoder's Hampshire gilt won reserve grand champion; the club sold 410 pounds of pecans in the fall fundraiser and cleared $1,180, which pays for the spring trip to the state fairgrounds; the December meeting moves to Tuesday the 9th at 7 p.m. at the Bremen Public Library because the fire station hall is being repainted; we need two parent volunteers to drive to the state fair trip. Write it now, don't ask me questions.

Write the About page for my real estate website. I'm Teresa Walsh, an agent with Lakeshore Realty in Ludington, Michigan. Facts: licensed since 2011; I grew up in Scottville, 9 miles east; before real estate I taught 4th grade for six years; I've sold 312 homes, about half to first-time buyers; I speak Spanish; I only work Mason and Lake counties; I answer texts until 9 p.m. My phone is (231) 555-0144. Write it now, don't ask me questions.

Write a blog post for my fishing guide business, Big Two-Hearted Outfitters, on what to bring for a fall steelhead float trip on the Pere Marquette River. Facts from me: trips run October through early December; water is 38 to 46 degrees; I supply rods, reels, flies and the drift boat; bring breathable waders and wading boots without felt soles because Michigan bans felt on some rivers (I won't let felt in my boat); wear layers, no cotton; a Michigan fishing license with an all-species endorsement is required; we launch at 7 a.m. from the Gleason's Landing access; trips are $525 for two people. Write it now, don't ask me questions.
